text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends to refuse the installation of an All-Way Stop Control at the intersection of Park Street and Sharpe Street as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location currently has a stop control facing the north and southbound on Sharpe Street approach of this four legs intersection.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Park Street and Sharpe Street.
